agent.reasons: The entity is located in Vietnam (VN), and so is the control person and 67% owner Yusuf Zhou. Vietnam is on FATF's increased-monitoring list, so 6.2 requires escalation to EDD. This assumes Vietnam is still on that list at the 2026-10-27 review date, which the case file does not show. Two problems would each also require requesting documents: the owners of Ember Holdings LLC (33%) are unknown, so ownership is not complete (3.3), and the registry filing dated 2025-06-16 is more than 12 months old (3.5). Under 2.1 the more severe outcome, escalation, governs.
still_needed: Confirmation that Vietnam is on FATF's increased-monitoring list as of 2026-10-27
The beneficial owners of Ember Holdings LLC (33% holder), identified and with verified identities
A registry filing less than 12 months old
